title: The PP/NAO/ABFS actually used must equal the selected database element set
rule: Every run that names a database element set must hash the PP/NAO/ABFS payloads it will actually use and compare them with the selected set. A mismatch, a missing payload, or several competing payloads for one element/role blocks the run, including replay and reused-data runs. Declaring a database basis is not evidence that the computation used it.
